one_off_payments.what: Estimated reduction-in-force (about 30% of workforce) severance and related costs announced April 2022. The filing gives estimated costs, not confirmed cash paid.
one_off_payments.quote: The total costs related to the reduction in force are estimated to be approximately $1.0 million in research and development and $0.2 million in general and administrative, primarily related to severance costs and related expenses.
